title: Support the CSS Functions and Mixins draft spec
impact: 18 thumbs-up on the issue plus several '+1' comments (2025-2026); one commenter wrote a userland visitor polyfill using customAtRules. Related: open PR #1356 (2026-10-01) implementing @function behind a new `customFunctions` draft flag; older closed #497/#964 and open #1071 concern the unrelated non-standard custom-at-rule mixin example in the docs.
summary: Request to support css-mixins-1 (@function, @mixin/@apply). Today all three pass through unchanged as unknown at-rules (a warning, not an error, even in strict mode), and `--fn()` calls are kept as written, so CSS using them isn't broken. Functions ship only in Chrome 139+ (MDN BCD: experimental; Firefox/Safari not yet), and mixins ship in no browser, so under the project philosophy anything here belongs behind a draft flag. PR #1356 already proposes the @function half.
repro: 788-repro.mjs / 788-repro-recovery.mjs: `@function --double(--x <length>) returns <length> { result: calc(var(--x) * 2) } @mixin --m(--c){color:var(--c)} .box{width:--double(10px); @apply --m(red)}` with minify -> passed through unchanged with warnings 'Unknown at rule: @function; @mixin; @apply' on local master, 1.33.0 and 1.32.0.
evidence: Spec: css-mixins-1 Overview.bs is 'Status: ED', 'Work Status: Exploring'; the ED defines @function plus @mixin/@apply. MDN BCD (local node_modules): css.at-rules.function chrome 139, firefox false, safari false, experimental; no @mixin/@apply entry. Issue index: PR #1356 open with no review comments.

fix.approach: Functions: review PR #1356 (draft flag `customFunctions`). A design point for the maintainer: build-time resolution is only meaning-preserving when the body and arguments don't depend on custom properties from the element's cascade or inheritance (the spec evaluates functions at computed-value time in the caller's context). The PR resolves var() from the rule containing the call, which can differ, so unresolvable cases should probably be left as written. Mixins: wait for at least one engine to ship or multiple engines to commit, per the draft-feature policy.

draftReply:
Thanks for the request, and for all the research in this thread. Where things stand: Lightning CSS currently passes `@function`, `@mixin` and `@apply` through unchanged (with an 'unknown at rule' warning), so stylesheets that use them for Chrome aren't broken. The spec is still an Editor's Draft, and so far only Chrome ships `@function`; no browser ships mixins yet. Anything here would go behind a `drafts` option, like `customMedia`. There's an open PR, #1356, that adds `@function` support behind a draft flag; it's waiting for review. Mixins would come later, once the spec and browser support settle.
